name: aquabaseline
description: Smart Water Monitoring That Learns What 'Normal' Looks Like

scripts.setup: npm run setup:backend && npm run setup:frontend
scripts.setup:backend: python3 -m venv backend/.venv && backend/.venv/bin/pip install --upgrade pip && backend/.venv/bin/pip install -r backend/requirements.txt
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c green,cyan "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run build:frontend
